g.text: S
SETTING
private!
P
PERCEPTION
"what…?"
I
INVITATION
"tell…?"
K
KNOWLEDGE
warn + plain!
E
EMOTIONS
hold space!
S
STRATEGY
plan!
SPIKES (Baile — exam pure!): Setting (private + sit + who stays?) · Perception ("what
have you understood so far…?") · Invitation ("shall I explain everything today…?") ·
Knowledge (warning shot + plain words + PAUSE!) · Emotions (reflect + hold space!) ·
Strategy + Summary (plan + teach-back + follow-up!).
WARNING SHOT: "I'm afraid the results are serious…" — then PAUSE. Plain: "the cancer has
spread" — not "metastatic progression observed". One fact, then silence; shock hears ONE
sentence — repeat visits beat information dumps.
EMOTIONS: reflect ("this is devastating…") + presence + tissue-near + hand-offered + NO
fixing ("don't cry" banned!). Anger at YOU? Don't defend — "I hear your fury — tell me…"
(M04.2 de-escalation!). Denial? Don't bulldoze — "take time; I'll return" (M04.2!).
CULTURE: "who decides + who hears?" FIRST — patient? spouse? elder? "Shall we call your…?"
Faith framing honoured ("God and medicine together"); interpreters ADULT + trained, never
children (M05!). Document who was told what, in whose presence.
NURSE'S ROLE: often the STAYER — doctor delivers, nurse remains ("what did you hear…?
what scares you most…?"). Clarify, comfort, connect (doctor/chaplain/social), revisit.
STRATEGY: hope + honesty TOGETHER ("we can't cure, but we CAN control pain + keep you
home + support family" — realistic hope!). Written summary + next contact + red flags.
DEBRIEF YOU (M02!): bad-news conversations wound givers too — share, reflect, recover.
LINKS: M02 presence/silence · M03 ladder · GER M6 dying · PRO-I truth-telling.
MANTRA: "private, perceive, invite, warn-plain-pause, hold, plan."
